note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Lisnaskea rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Two divisions were contested, Newtownbutler and Mullynagoan, both won by Unionists from Anti-Partitionists. The Fermanagh Herald prints the uncontested nominations. Ten divisions added 7 Nov 2026 from the same Fermanagh Herald list (page image read). Clonkeelan: 'No nomination was received for Clonkeelan, formerly represented by Mr. Hugh P. McMahon, who will be re-elected, however, if he signs a consent paper' (Fermanagh Herald, 21 May 1949, p. 3); he is named as the outgoing member for Clonkeelan in 1952 (Fermanagh Herald, 24 May 1952, p. 6), but no report of the new council in 1949 naming him was found, so the division is not filled. The Impartial Reporter of 9 June 1949, p. 5, likewise says that, no nomination having been received for Clonkeelan, 'it is assumed that the outgoing member, Mr. Hugh McMahon, will be elected'; no Reporter report of the new council in 1949 naming him was found (Impartial Reporter pass 2, 7 Nov 2026). In place of James Goodwin. Returned unopposed.
